title: Holder snapshot indexer
goal: Produce a real, authenticated HKMN holder balance snapshot from finalized Transfer logs, excluding non-holder addresses.
steps: Read HKMN Transfer logs from Robinhood RPC up to a fixed finalized block and fold them into current per-address balances
Compute the exclusion list: canonical pool, hook, vault, every per-cycle escrow (via the same CREATE2 formula the contracts use), treasury
Produce the hookemon.hkmn-holder-snapshot.v1 schema: finalized block number/hash, per-holder balance, total supply, exclusion list with justification
Add a synthetic Transfer-log fixture test proving two independent runs from the same finalized block produce byte-identical snapshots
acceptance: Snapshot schema matches what reconcile.mjs's existing validateSnapshot already expects
Excluded addresses (pool/hook/vault/every escrow/treasury) never appear as recipients
Two independent runs against the same finalized block produce identical output (TB-16 dual-builder requirement)
notes: Log-derived, not eth_call-derived, specifically so a second builder can independently reproduce it.
